variants.label: P1 · 环形高压释放
variants.prompt: Strict MODEL reference: preserve the exact original ivory six-petal HELIOS mechanical egg, machined metal skeleton, real hinges, three gyro rings and seven-button pedestal, no redesigned robot, no extra shells. Make a cinematic AAA game cutscene VFX concept storyboard, physically credible high-pressure machinery, artistic direction like an expensive Atomic Heart-inspired retrofuture in-engine cinematic. Four landscape keyframes in a 2x2 wide plate, large detailed model, dark neutral industrial studio, identical fixed 3/4 camera and model scale throughout; label only short state and time stamps. Absolutely avoid cheap neon outlining every edge, giant glowing geometry circles, spark confetti, magic runes, uniformly glowing wires and fireworks. Need sophisticated light hierarchy, desaturated near-black shadows, controlled filmic speculars on aged warm nickel and ivory enamel. The GAS must originate from a continuous 360-degree annular pressure gap all around the egg's lower circumference directly above the mechanical cradle, NOT merely one or two tiny side nozzles. Opening the petals also releases substantial vapor from between the actual separating shell seams and the interior chamber. Show the vapor catching on and flowing along the inner surfaces, with turbulent detailed rolling edges and multiple density scales. The pressure plume is substantial and dimensional, fast directional jets at source transitioning to a broad rolling low cloud, highly legible backlit white-to-gray condensation with cool shadow cores and localized warm scattering. Carefully keep at least 70 percent of the open mechanism visible. Steam is not fire and not a flat smoke decal. The scene is fixed frame, no camera zoom. Real model thickness and speculars stay central. Variant P1 'ANNULAR PRESSURE'. Four phases: 01 'LOCK / 0.00s' closed egg nearly dark, only a hot narrow orange filament visible through the inspection window, a dim real inset base status light. 02 'PURGE / 0.45s' all six latches unlock, petals separated by a narrow gap, a forceful continuous ring of vapor erupts horizontally and slightly downward from the entire bottom shell seam, physically scattered light reveals a dense white inner vapor front and transparent outer rolling edges, broad steam plume spreads around the pedestal without covering buttons; chamber seams leaking too. 03 'REVEAL / 1.30s' six petals now open, large escaping gas sheets curl along the inner petal surfaces and peel away as the core is revealed as a contained orange-white miniature sun; a brief intense but controlled chamber bounce light on the mechanisms. Just TWO or THREE localized branching electric contacts at the gyro trunnions, no orbit hoop graphics; minimal sparks. 04 'AFTERGLOW / 3.20s' fully open resting sculpture, most smoke cleared, a few heavy mist eddies drifting from the annular base gap and shell interior, bright detailed core, nuanced moving ring speculars, deep dark machined metal, expensive quiet power. The gas is substantially bigger and more forceful than ordinary small valve puffs. Restrained, cinematic, grounded industrial physics.
